decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems is core to the firm's hearing-care offer and digital manufacturing workflow, so sunk investment and strategic fit favour persistence despite only a modest website presence.
The individual EARsleeve has its own page and is publicly positioned as completing universal in-ear systems, a visible commitment central to the announced direction that makes withdrawal unlikely.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core business, but it was launched only recently with its own page, so the public commitment and new investment lead management to attribute weak early results to start-up effects and persist.

The post-curing unit complements the firm's additive and digital production systems and is recently launched, so integration into its workflow strategy argues for keeping it, although the earlier withdrawal of the thermoforming unit shows equipment can be cut.
